text:
Type: grey fleece throw blanket
Use: keeping warm on a sofa, armchair or bed; living room, bedroom
Style: Scandinavian, minimalist, contemporary
Materials: soft brushed fleece with a matte surface
Colors: dark heathered grey
Shape: large flat rectangle that drapes and folds easily, plain surface, scalloped cut edges along the short ends, thin and light
Feel: cozy, soft, casual
Goes with: grey or white sofas, wool and knit textiles, light wood; Scandinavian or minimalist living rooms

product.name: POLARVIDE
product.description: The fleece throw feels soft against your skin and can be machine washed.
